analysis_kind: descriptive observation feasibility; no relevance outcomes

definitions.eligible_queries: qrel queries with a nonempty run from every one of the five sources
definitions.full_arm: four complete supplied lexical lists plus the selected source top1000
definitions.judged: qrel document membership, including explicit grade zero; grades are discarded
definitions.outside_candidates: new-source documents outside the original lexical full-list union in both arms
definitions.paired_observability: intersection of visible-only query eligibility across arms; no effect contrast
definitions.pooled_counts: query-document counts, not independent document samples or mean per-query fractions
definitions.shared_depth_arm: all five full-arm lists cropped to Dq=min(200,minimum full-arm source length)
definitions.specialist: fixed original full-arm owner top10 and absent every other original full-arm top30
definitions.support_group: tail_supported iff any other original full-arm source rank>30; otherwise isolated
definitions.visible_only: fixed-cohort members still present in their owning source for the specified arm

limits: Judgment coverage is potentially nonrandom and cannot establish relevance or comparative retrieval quality.
Query counts and judged fractions alone do not establish precision or sample-size adequacy.
The two depth arms reuse queries and documents and are not independent samples.
These previously explored annual panels are not untouched evaluation data.
